scope: First source-level extension: fixed-M Poisson mixture with Gaussian base measure on log rates

checks.scope: Entire portable numerical suite, CLI validation and Poisson extension
Base-R wrapper contract and root-inference checks
Real Julia sampling through R and Python with root inference, paths with spaces/quotes, identical seeded draws and independent Poisson target reconstruction

limitations: Fixed total component count; this extension is not an MFM
No Poisson split-merge or tempering implementation
Independent numerical quadrature checks partition probabilities for one tiny problem (n=3, M=2)
Mixing for the supplied demonstration dataset and arbitrary new data is unassessed
Per-count and total counts must be smaller than 2^53 under the shared Float64 CSV protocol
ci: The repository workflow runs the full suite and integration_smoke.py on each pull request. Consult the PR checks for commit-specific remote results.
